Write a brief academic-style statement distinguishing a legal boundary on a map from the way residents describe their neighborhood. Aim for approximately 28–44 English tokens.

message.content: A legal boundary on a map denotes an official, jurisdictional line. Residents’ descriptions of their neighborhood often reflect perceived, social, and historical identities that may diverge from that cartographic demarcation.
